metadata.title: Statistical Uniformization of Surfaces by Heat-Kernel Fisher Information
metadata.abstract: A Brownian particle observed at time $t$ carries information about where it started. On a closed surface this makes the surface itself a statistical model, whose Fisher information pulls back to a heat-smoothed metric $h_t=2tJ_t$; its volume $V_t$ is a normalized Jeffreys volume, and $\log(V_t/2t)$ is the model-dependent constant in Rissanen's minimum-description-length complexity. We ask whether maximizing this statistical size among metrics of fixed area in a conformal class recovers the uniformizing metric. First, $9(A-2\pi\chi t-V_t)/t^2$ converges to the curvature energy $\int K^2\,dA$ (the Calabi energy up to a topological constant), uniformly on classes of bounded geometry; hence, within a fixed-area conformal class of bounded geometry containing the uniformizer, approximate maximizers of $V_t$ converge to the constant-curvature metric (on the sphere, to the round metrics). Second, near every flat torus we prove a sharp finite-scale version: for small perturbations whose oscillations are resolved by the diffusion, $t|k|^2\le\theta<\tau_*$, the flat-subtracted defect is comparable to $\|\Delta f\|_2^2$, uniformly in the frequency cutoff and over noncollapsing lattices. The explicit threshold $\tau_*=4.408\ldots$ is optimal, and it is exactly the observation time at which the information about one curvature mode is maximal. Third, the flat structure is seen only at an exponential scale: the volume loss of a flat torus measures the ambiguity of winding and is comparable to $t^{-1/2}e^{-\operatorname{sys}^2/(16t)}$, which selects the hexagonal lattice as $t\to0$ but not at all times.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 热核信息度量与曲面一致化
analysis.workSummary: 在闭曲面上由热核 Fisher 信息构造 h_t=2tJ_t 与体积 V_t，证明 9(A−2πχt−V_t)/t² 在有界几何类上一致趋于 ∫K²dA。因此在包含一致化度量、固定面积及有界几何的共形类中，V_t 的近似极大化子趋于常曲率度量（球面为圆度量族）。平坦环面附近另有频率限制 t|k|²≤θ<τ*=4.408… 下的有限尺度尖锐稳定性。
techniques: 热核 Fisher 度量的小时间展开
Calabi 曲率能量与固定面积共形变分
扩散可分辨频段的 Fourier 分析
环面绕行歧义的指数小估计
analysis.breakthrough: 把统计体积最大化与曲率能量最小化相连；平坦环面的体积亏损与 t^(−1/2)exp(−sys²/(16t)) 同阶，在 t→0 时选择六角格，但不在所有时刻如此。
analysis.limitations: 一致化收敛依赖有界几何与固定面积、共形类控制；有限尺度界局限小扰动及可分辨频率，指数估计只是可比界，不是精确渐近系数，六角格选择也仅小时间。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
